card.name: The word of after a liquid volume
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after a measured amount such as "5 mL" or "1 cup" in mixing or reconstitution directions. It expects the liquid to be named next, such as water, saline or Ora-Plus.

modes.label: Volume then of
modes.description: "of" after a volume in mL or cups, before the diluent or vehicle is named.
modes.example: Add 80 mL<< of>> Ora-Plus®* oral susp

modes.label: Space after Add
modes.description: The gap after "Add" just before the volume, in the same preparation steps.
modes.example: Add<< >>5 mL of water to a catheter

card.writes: It promotes mostly unrelated Chinese and technical tokens, so there is no clear effect on the next word.
card.plain: It lights up on "of" after an amount of liquid in directions for mixing or diluting a medicine.
